note: Top-level fields of the generated registries. sync_registries.mjs writes the registries from these plus the manifests; keyOrder keeps their original layout.

benchmarkSets.note: Benchmark environments. Each entry names a map and the makeReachSets parameters for its route sets. The factory and building entries reproduce the existing methodology v3 sets exactly (empty parameters = the original defaults). The scene text is the only part of the coding prompt that differs between environments. Mission sets (missions.search, missions.delivery) are generated by sim/tools/maps/make_mission_sets.mjs; each target location appears in exactly one set, so test hikers and pads are never seen in training.
benchmarkSets.v5Note: v5 environments (factory5, canyon5, residential5) have fresh seeds and test sets never used before. canyon5 uses sim/maps/canyon-v5.json (hollows and sub-floor void sealed). Search hikers and delivery pads sit on sky-facing ground (surface: sky).

benchmarkMaps.note: Parameters for sim/tools/maps/build_splat_map.mjs. Each benchmark map is rebuilt from the cached SuperSplat collider with exactly these values.

rescueScenes.coordinateSystem: PlayCanvas right-handed Y-up; each asset has an explicit transform into scene world

transformEvidence.finding: The official cZ asset loader creates a gsplat entity and applies setLocalEulerAngles(0,0,180) for SOG/PLY, except LCC2 uses270X and SPZ is unrotated. Camera initial position/target pass directly to camera setup. The current selected assets are SOG; these rules are not universal across file formats.
transformEvidence.caution: Renderer coordinate alignment is distinct from physical scale calibration. New scenes currently retain source scale1.
